title: Training Week 2026 registration
description: Training Week runs 26–28 October 2026 in Toronto: lab tours, Lunch & Learns, skills workshops and the innovation showcase. It is open to anyone already in a BioHubNet program — ENGAGE, EXPERIENCE, or having submitted an EQUIP application. Choose and rank the sessions you would like; places are confirmed by the team, and we will email you about a week beforehand. The Annual Symposium on 29 October is a separate registration.

fields.help: You already have a BioHubNet training platform account, which is what ENGAGE and EXPERIENCE need. Training Week places go to people in ENGAGE, EXPERIENCE or EQUIP, so apply to whichever program fits. EQUIP does not require a BioHubNet training platform account — you apply to it directly, and the application counts from the moment you submit it, funded or not. Read about all three at biohubnet.ca, then come back to this form.
fields.label: One step first: join a program.

fields.help: Create a BioHubNet training platform account, then apply to either ENGAGE or EXPERIENCE. Both programs run on the training platform, so the account comes first. Start at biohubnet.ca, then return to this form once you have applied.
fields.label: Create an account, then apply to either ENGAGE or EXPERIENCE.

fields.help: Your institutional email, or the secondary email registered with us. We check it against the BioHubNet programme lists — ENGAGE, EXPERIENCE, or an EQUIP application — and you need to be on one of them to register for Training Week. If we cannot find your address, the form will tell you at this question rather than at the end. Just been accepted, or applied under a different address? Email your programme coordinator and they can add you by hand — it takes a minute.

fields.help: Pick as many as you want — one, or all of them — in order of preference. The number on each is your ranking, taken from the order you clicked, and it is what we go by when a room is oversubscribed. Sessions drawn side by side in the calendar are on at the SAME TIME: you can still choose both, and it is worth doing if you would take either, but only one of them can be approved. The two Monday tours are different: CCRM is in downtown Toronto and Catalent is in London, about two hours away, so you cannot do both even though the times do not overlap — choose the one you want.
